lines.zh: 我在蘑菇岛的草地上小步快走。
lines.en: I trot in short steps across mushroom island grass.

lines.zh: 我的鸡爪踩过菌丝，声音很轻。
lines.en: My chicken feet cross mycelium with a soft patter.

lines.zh: 走路时背上的菌盖一晃一晃。
lines.en: As I walk, the cap on my back wobbles.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚后跟，不是跟着你。
lines.en: I follow your heels, not you exactly.

lines.zh: 岛上没有别的颜色，只有红和棕。
lines.en: The island holds no colors but red and brown.

lines.zh: 我抬头走路，怕菌盖撞到矮枝。
lines.en: I walk with my head up so the cap clears branches.

lines.zh: 三只咯菇排成一列，像一盘点心。
lines.en: Three cluckshrooms in a row look like a snack plate.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，因为蛋快下来了。
lines.en: I hurry, because an egg is on its way.

lines.zh: 菌丝在脚下发软，像旧地毯。
lines.en: The mycelium gives underfoot like an old carpet.

lines.zh: 我绕过那丛红蘑菇，是我亲戚。
lines.en: I walk around that red mushroom; it is family.

lines.zh: 迈一步，抖一下，再迈一步。
lines.en: One step, a shake, then one more step.

lines.zh: 我的影子上面长着一顶伞。
lines.en: My shadow wears a little umbrella on its head.

lines.zh: 我去找阴凉处，菌盖怕晒。
lines.en: I head for shade; my cap dislikes the sun.

lines.zh: 你走得比我快，但我会绕近路。
lines.en: You walk faster, but I know the shorter path.

lines.zh: 我小跑着去追一片飘下来的叶子。
lines.en: I trot after a falling leaf.

lines.zh: 菌盖太重，我走起来有点歪。
lines.en: My cap is heavy and I walk a little crooked.

lines.zh: 我蹲在菌丝上，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I squat on the mycelium and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 背上这顶蘑菇，是我最得意的地方。
lines.en: The mushroom on my back is my finest feature.

lines.zh: 咕咕，咕咕，我在跟自己说话。
lines.en: Cluck, cluck; I am talking to myself again.

lines.zh: 风吹过菌褶，声音像翻书。
lines.en: Wind through my gills sounds like turning pages.

lines.zh: 我在数岛上还剩几朵蘑菇。
lines.en: I am counting how many mushrooms are left here.

lines.zh: 红的那朵今天特别亮。
lines.en: The red one looks especially bright today.

lines.zh: 我抖抖羽毛，掉下一点孢子。
lines.en: I shake my feathers and a little spore dust falls.

lines.zh: 蛋在肚子下面暖着，很舒服。
lines.en: The egg under my belly is warm and comfortable.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的海，那边没有蘑菇。
lines.en: I stare at the far sea; no mushrooms grow there.

lines.zh: 有人来剪蘑菇的话，我会站着不动。
lines.en: If someone comes to shear me, I will stand still.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，是在听地下的菌丝。
lines.en: My head tilts as I listen to the underground mycelium.

lines.zh: 这一身羽毛不太会飞，只能扑腾。
lines.en: These feathers barely fly; they mostly just flap.

lines.zh: 阳光一小块一小块落在草地上。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on the grass in small patches.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，味道像湿土。
lines.en: I burp, and it tastes like damp soil.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀上的菌丝里。
lines.en: I tuck my head into the mycelium on my wings.

lines.zh: 岛上很闷，可我喜欢这个味道。
lines.en: The island is stuffy, but I like the smell.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是有剪刀？
lines.en: Is that a pair of shears in your hand?

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，菌盖也跟着歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head, and the cap tilts with it.

lines.zh: 你身上有蘑菇的味道，很陌生。
lines.en: You smell of mushrooms, but not the ones here.

lines.zh: 别踩我的菌丝，那是我的地板。
lines.en: Do not trample my mycelium; that is my floor.

lines.zh: 你要红蘑菇还是棕的？
lines.en: Do you want the red mushroom or the brown one?

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，因为你很矮。
lines.en: I keep looking at you because you are rather short.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比我的圆多了。
lines.en: Your eyes are much rounder than mine.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们就能平视了。
lines.en: Crouch down, and we can look each other level.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，上次也是这双。
lines.en: I recognize those boots; you wore them last time.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋种子，我不吃。
lines.en: That bag of seeds in your hand, I do not eat.

lines.zh: 别突然伸手，我胆子很小。
lines.en: Do not reach out suddenly; I startle easily.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的菌盖很好笑吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is my cap funny?

lines.zh: 别砍我的菌盖，会疼很久。
lines.en: Do not cut my cap; it aches for a long time.

lines.zh: 我咕了一声，往蘑菇丛里躲。
lines.en: I cluck once and hide among the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 羽毛飞了几根，不算大事。
lines.en: A few feathers flew off; nothing serious.

lines.zh: 你下手太重了，我只是只鸡。
lines.en: You hit too hard; I am only a chicken.

lines.zh: 伤口在翅膀下，我自己舔不到。
lines.en: The wound is under my wing where I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，把菌盖挡在前面。
lines.en: I curl up and hide behind my own cap.

lines.zh: 血落在菌丝上，颜色很怪。
lines.en: Blood on the mycelium makes an odd color.

lines.zh: 你再打一下，我就跑远了。
lines.en: One more hit and I will run far away.

lines.zh: 我很软，这一下真的很痛。
lines.en: I am soft, and that one truly hurt.

lines.zh: 我歪着走开，翅膀拖着地。
lines.en: I waddle away, one wing dragging the ground.

lines.zh: 你撒的那些种子，我一口都不吃。
lines.en: I will not eat a single seed you scatter.

lines.zh: 我追着你，是想看看剪刀。
lines.en: I follow you to get a closer look at those shears.

lines.zh: 面包屑？我更喜欢湿木头。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs? I would rather have damp wood.

lines.zh: 你晃着胡萝卜，我完全不心动。
lines.en: You wave a carrot, and I feel absolutely nothing.

lines.zh: 我只对菌丝和阴凉处有兴趣。
lines.en: Only mycelium and shade hold any interest for me.

lines.zh: 你把小麦举高，我够不到也不想够。
lines.en: You lift the wheat high; I cannot reach and will not try.

lines.zh: 那种子看起来很干，不合我胃口。
lines.en: Those seeds look dry, and they do not suit me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，因为你会掉东西。
lines.en: I trail behind you because you drop things.

lines.zh: 别费心了，我只吃岛上长的。
lines.en: Save your effort; I eat only what grows here.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味就退后一步。
lines.en: The moment I smell sweetness, I step back.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西亮亮的，不是食物。
lines.en: The thing in your hand shines; it is not food.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着跑开，不是因为怕你。
lines.en: I flap away, and it is not from fear of you.

lines.zh: 你追我三步，我就绕你一圈。
lines.en: You chase three steps, and I circle once around you.

lines.zh: 想让我过去？拿剪刀来。
lines.en: Want me to come over? Bring the shears.

lines.zh: 你把蘑菇举起来，我腿就动了。
lines.en: You raise a mushroom and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 那朵红的，我不能吃，是亲戚。
lines.en: Not the red one; that is family.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，让一让。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; please move aside.

lines.zh: 我头顶的蘑菇被撞歪了。
lines.en: The mushroom on my head knocks askew.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖碰到你的膝盖，弹了一下。
lines.en: My cap taps your knee and bounces off.

lines.zh: 别推，蛋在我肚子下面。
lines.en: Do not push; there is an egg under my belly.

lines.zh: 我们一起往旁边挪半步吧。
lines.en: Let us both shuffle half a step sideways.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了我的蘑菇。
lines.en: You knocked off one of my mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我背上长蘑菇，剪下来红的棕的都有。
lines.en: Mushrooms grow on me. Red and brown, cut away.

lines.zh: 你很大，我很软，这不公平。
lines.en: You are large, I am soft, and that is unfair.

lines.zh: 我叽了一声，是抗议，不是害怕。
lines.en: I cluck once in protest, not in fear.

lines.zh: 靠边站，我要去那丛蘑菇那儿。
lines.en: Step aside; I am heading for that mushroom patch.

lines.zh: 我们咯菇也会互相理毛。
lines.en: We cluckshrooms groom each other's feathers too.

lines.zh: 你看，我们两只的菌盖颜色不一样。
lines.en: Look, our two caps are not the same color.

lines.zh: 繁殖时我会把蛋藏进菌丝里。
lines.en: When breeding, I hide the egg in the mycelium.

lines.zh: 咕咕，咕咕，这是打招呼的方式。
lines.en: Cluck, cluck; that is how we greet each other.

lines.zh: 我们围着圈转，像两朵会走的蘑菇。
lines.en: We circle each other like two walking mushrooms.

lines.zh: 仪式很短，之后各自找虫子。
lines.en: The ritual is short; afterward we hunt bugs separately.

lines.zh: 她的菌盖比我的更红。
lines.en: Her cap is a deeper red than mine.

lines.zh: 我们的蛋会孵出带菌的小鸡。
lines.en: Our eggs hatch chicks already wearing mushrooms.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在互相点头。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are nodding at each other.

lines.zh: 两只咯菇挨着站，就很安心。
lines.en: Two cluckshrooms standing close feel quite safe.

lines.zh: 地上掉了一朵蘑菇，我捡起来。
lines.en: A mushroom fell to the ground, so I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我用喙叼着，走得很稳。
lines.en: I carry it in my beak and walk steadily.

lines.zh: 这粒种子，留给别人吧。
lines.en: This seed I will leave for someone else.

lines.zh: 喙太小，只能叼很小的一块。
lines.en: My beak is small, so I carry only small pieces.

lines.zh: 我捡到一根羽毛，是自己的。
lines.en: I found a feather, and it is one of mine.

lines.zh: 掉下的东西，我会先闻一闻。
lines.en: Anything dropped, I sniff before touching.

lines.zh: 我把它推进草丛里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into the grass and hide it well.

lines.zh: 这个亮亮的，不能吃，放下。
lines.en: This shiny thing is not food; I put it down.

lines.zh: 我叼着走两步，又掉了。
lines.en: I carry it two steps before dropping it again.

lines.zh: 收集是我的爱好，不是需求。
lines.en: Collecting is my hobby, not my need.

lines.zh: 我看见你的剪刀了，那就是目标。
lines.en: I see your shears, and those are the target.

lines.zh: 你踩到的菌丝，引起我的注意。
lines.en: The mycelium you trampled caught my attention.

lines.zh: 我盯上你手里的那朵蘑菇。
lines.en: I have set my sights on your mushroom.

lines.zh: 你往蘑菇林走，我陪你。
lines.en: You head for the mushroom grove; I will join.

lines.zh: 那个角落有东西在动，我过去。
lines.en: Something moves in that corner, so I go.

lines.zh: 目标不是敌人，是一块阴凉。
lines.en: My target is not an enemy, but some shade.

lines.zh: 我看见红点，就朝那边跑。
lines.en: I spot something red and run toward it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步让地面震了一下。
lines.en: Your step made the ground tremble a little.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那丛最高的蘑菇。
lines.en: I locked onto the tallest mushroom in the patch.

lines.zh: 谁掉了东西，我就追谁。
lines.en: Whoever drops something, that is who I follow.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，咯咯地叫个不停。
lines.en: I follow you, clucking without pause.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的小眼睛就到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my little eyes go too.

lines.zh: 我不攻击，只是好奇地看着。
lines.en: I am not attacking; I am only watching, curious.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我记着呢。
lines.en: I have not forgotten what is in your hand.

lines.zh: 你转过来，我就退半步。
lines.en: You turn around, so I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，是在量距离。
lines.en: I circle you to measure the distance.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我扑腾一下跳开。
lines.en: You wave your arm, and I flap away.

lines.zh: 你口袋里好像有菌丝味。
lines.en: Your pocket smells faintly of mycelium.

lines.zh: 你的影子很长，我躲在里面。
lines.en: Your shadow is long, so I hide inside it.

lines.zh: 我一直在你脚边打转。
lines.en: I keep circling right around your feet.

lines.zh: 我啄你一下，是因为你先碰我。
lines.en: I peck you once because you touched me first.

lines.zh: 我的喙很小，但很尖。
lines.en: My beak is small, but it is sharp.

lines.zh: 别抓我的菌盖，那是命根子。
lines.en: Do not grab my cap; it is my whole life.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，翅膀拍得你满脸灰。
lines.en: I lunge, wings flapping dust into your face.

lines.zh: 这一啄只够提醒你松手。
lines.en: This peck is only enough to make you let go.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓地，用力蹬了一脚。
lines.en: My claws grip the dirt, and I kick hard.

lines.zh: 我的喙撞在你护膝上。
lines.en: My beak clacks against your knee guard.

lines.zh: 你惹到我了，咕咕。
lines.en: You have annoyed me; cluck, cluck.

lines.zh: 羽毛全炸开，我已经准备好了。
lines.en: Every feather puffs out; I am ready now.

lines.zh: 我的攻击很短，打完就跑。
lines.en: My attack is brief; I strike and run.

lines.zh: 我从菌丝里钻出来，一身孢子。
lines.en: I push out of the mycelium covered in spores.

lines.zh: 这座岛只长蘑菇，正好适合我。
lines.en: This island grows only mushrooms, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我生在这里，也只想留在这里。
lines.en: I was born here and mean to stay here.

lines.zh: 第一声咕咕，是给这座岛的。
lines.en: My first cluck is dedicated to this island.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时，背上就顶着伞。
lines.en: I hatched already wearing an umbrella on my back.

lines.zh: 岛上很安静，只有我和海。
lines.en: The island is quiet, just me and the sea.

lines.zh: 雾气散了，我就出现在这里。
lines.en: The mist cleared, and here I appeared.

lines.zh: 三朵蘑菇围着我，像家人。
lines.en: Three mushrooms surround me like family.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我的菌盖也醒了。
lines.en: Day broke, and my cap woke up with me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖羽毛，开始今天的散步。
lines.en: I shake my feathers and start today's stroll.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到羽毛，一下就焦了。
lines.en: The flame touched my feathers and singed them at once.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，菌盖先着地。
lines.en: I fell from a height and landed cap first.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我浮不起来了。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers, and I stop floating.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的菌盖掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked my cap crooked.

lines.zh: 箭插在菌盖上，像一根牙签。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my cap like a toothpick.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的孢子全飘了出来。
lines.en: The magic shook every spore loose from me.

lines.zh: 岛上蘑菇吃完了，我饿得发软。
lines.en: The island's mushrooms ran out, and I feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓进了蘑菇丛。
lines.en: The thunder drove me straight into the mushroom patch.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我连扑腾都不会。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I cannot even flap.
